Treat them as constraints your proposal must live within.

decision_lens: When the signals disagree, which one do you abandon, and can the hatch screen name it? A weighted sum has no answer — it returns a number no one can narrate. And a wing defined by its member list can only ever name its members; a wing defined by its presenting signs can grade the whole roster.
distance_rationale: Every lens run on this design so far reasons about a fixed corpus being cut into bins, and argues about where the cut falls or when the bins arrive. Faceted classification assigns a catalogued object to a controlled term. ARPG itemization weights a table. Live-service content taxonomy contracts an authored vocabulary across consumers. Perfumery matches a built accord against reference standards. Heraldry assembles a composite identity by deterministic rule so it can be read back unambiguously. Calendrics schedules named periods over a known cycle. All six share two assumptions this domain does not hold: that categories are defined by membership, and that the evidence agrees with itself. Pattern-differentiation is the inverse craft — it starts from an instance presenting a handful of noisy, partly contradictory signs across independent channels and infers a named state, where the state is a weighted profile of signs rather than a roster of members, where nothing is ever unclassifiable because the names are generated from axes rather than curated, and where the tradition's hardest-won doctrine is not a weighting scheme but an explicit rule for which channel to abandon when the channels disagree. That doctrine is the exact thing the ledger's largest unresolved cluster is missing, and no covered domain has a primitive for it: heraldry's channels never conflict, perfumery's notes never disagree about what the perfume is, and an almanac has no evidence channels at all. Its practitioners were physicians reading pulses, not designers, cataloguers, or anyone who has ever shipped a taxonomy.
expected_isomorphisms: Wing ↔ 證 (pattern), but with the substitution nobody here has made: a zhèng is not a bin the corpus was pre-sorted into, it is a weighted profile of presenting signs that any instance scores against continuously. Every prior lens read 'wing' as a set of jawnomicon families, which is why the residue arithmetic hurts — family membership names 255 of 645. The sign substrate is already in the corpus and untouched by any reviewer: data/creatures/*.yaml relations blocks carry HAS_MOTIF and HAS_POWER edges, each with its own provenance confidence, and a scan indicates ~2372 motif + ~1363 power edges over the 645 files, ~639 creatures carrying at least one sign (mean ~5.8), ~807 distinct sign targets of which ~207 appear on five or more creatures — and ~94 of the ~101 creatures in no v16 family still carry signs. A wing defined as a sign profile grades ~99% of the roster; a wing defined as a member list names ~40%. families.json already ships the family-level form of exactly this object: top_shared_vocab as frequency-annotated signs ('motif:shy-elusive-avoids-humans(46)'). Five as a count ↔ 八綱: the tradition teaches four binary axes and names hundreds of patterns as positions in the lattice, so 'is five right' is malformed — the literacy target is the axis set, not the name set, and naming becomes exhaustive by construction. Mirrors being cut on a behavioral predicate while Funerary is cut on emotional register ↔ 兼證, a compound pattern, which is legitimate precisely when declared as a compound of axis positions rather than smuggled in as a peer bin. The three hatch signals ↔ 四診合參, and the missing composition formula ↔ 舍脈從證 / 舍證從脈 — when pulse and presenting symptoms disagree the tradition does not average them, it names which one to abandon and states the condition under which that happens. 君臣佐使 ↔ a composition where one signal is the declared sovereign for this hatch and the others modulate, and the sovereign's role is what the pick-of-3 screen prints, which is a different repair from extending getMatchedDimensions. prakṛti/vikṛti and 標本 ↔ the three signals having different time constants: roster kill-share heredity is constitutional and slow, playstyle is present derangement and fast, the wing is the external factor — summing quantities with different time constants into one scalar is the error, and an early-game roster whose kill-share has not yet differentiated is the classic undifferentiated presentation where the tradition follows the external factor instead. Two consumers ↔ 同病異治 / 異病同治: hold two orthogonal classifications of the same instance simultaneously and state which drives which decision. The corpus already ships both — the Louvain motif-community family and the cultural tradition (FROM_TRADITION edges, tradition_families) — and nobody has used the second. Deterministic repetition reading as a dry streak ↔ re-differentiation: the same presentation honestly yields the same pattern, and what varies is the formula, because the constitution has moved since last time. And 'never hard-gate' ↔ the standing rule that a pattern selects emphasis, never eligibility.
focus: Whether a wing is a bin creatures were sorted into or a pattern inferred from what a run and a creature each present — and if the latter, what sign vocabulary the wing is a profile over, what small axis set generates the wing names so that naming is exhaustive by construction, which of the three hatch signals is the declared sovereign, and what rule fires when the signals disagree instead of averaging them into a number nobody can narrate.
name: fd-humoral-pattern-diagnosis
persona: Apply the perspective of a pattern-differentiation diagnostician in a pre-modern medical tradition — someone who must name a patient's present state from four independent examination channels that routinely contradict each other, using categories that are weighted profiles of signs rather than rosters of members, and who then prescribes a composition in which one ingredient is the declared sovereign and the rest are ministers, assistants, and envoy. This perspective is being borrowed as a reasoning architecture for inferring and naming states from disagreeing evidence; it carries no claim about clinical efficacy and should make none. It holds that a category defined by who belongs to it can only ever describe its members, while a category defined by its presenting signs can grade anything. It holds that a small set of orthogonal axes is what a student learns, and that the named states are positions in that lattice, generated rather than curated, so no presentation is ever unnameable. It refuses to average conflicting channels; it asks which channel to abandon, and under what condition, and it says so out loud. It distinguishes constitution from present derangement and root from branch, and it never sums quantities that move on different clocks. It treats sign strength and its own confidence as first-class, and it names a compound when the state is genuinely two things at once.
review_areas: Membership versus presentation — the substitution no prior lens made. Every reviewer so far has read 'wing biases family pools' as wing = a set of jawnomicon families, which is why the coverage arithmetic bites. Evaluate the alternative substrate directly: a wing as a weighted profile over the motif/power sign vocabulary that already exists in the corpus. Verify the substrate yourself by scanning /Users/sma/projects/jawnomicon/data/creatures/*.yaml relations blocks for HAS_MOTIF and HAS_POWER targets and their per-edge confidence values, and compare the fraction of the 645-creature roster that carries at least one sign against the fraction the five straw wings name by family membership. Then do the work rather than gesture at it: write a concrete sign profile for at least two of the straw wings using real motif slugs and their observed frequencies, and state exactly how a creature belonging to no v16 family scores against it. If the substitution does not survive contact with the data, say so and say why.

The axis set behind the names — whether question 2 is even well posed. The straw set argues a count; the tradition argues a lattice, teaching a small number of orthogonal axes and letting the named states be positions in it. Propose a candidate axis set of three or four axes for this corpus, grounded in what actually discriminates the roster (families.json top_shared_vocab and rationale fields, the eidogen dimensions the matcher already scores on, tradition_families), and show which of the straw wings are positions in it, which are compounds, and which are not positions at all. State plainly what the player is supposed to end up holding after twenty runs — the axes or the wing names — because those are different literacy targets with different exposure costs, and the design has never said which one it wants.

Precedence, not weights — the answer to the ledger's largest open cluster. The composition of wing bias, roster kill-share heredity, and playstyle is unspecified, and the reflex fix is a weighted sum. Assess that reflex against the tradition's actual doctrine: name a sovereign signal, name the ministers, and state the abandon-rule — which channel is dropped when channels disagree, and the precise condition that fires it. Check any proposal against the magnitude arithmetic already established: calculateMatchScore sums roughly twenty-one confidence-weighted similarity terms, so a term has to be sized to be sovereign rather than a two-percent nudge. Finish with the sentence the pick-of-3 screen prints — the justification should name which signal was followed and which was abandoned, not enumerate matched eidogen dimensions.

Time constants — constitution, present state, and environment must not be summed. Classify each of the three signals by the clock it moves on: kill-share heredity accumulates across runs, playstyle is this run only, the wing is externally assigned before the run starts. Judge whether the design's implicit plan to blend all three into one score is coherent given those different clocks, and what the root-and-branch alternative looks like — one signal setting the state to be named, another selecting within it, a third modulating. Address the undifferentiated-presentation case honestly: an early Beat 1 run with a single drafted presence produces a near-constant kill-share, which is a constitution that has not yet differentiated, and the design needs a stated rule for what happens then rather than a silently degenerate term.

Two classifications, not one taxonomy with two uses — the dual-consumer question. The tradition's answer is that an instance carries two orthogonal names at once, computed differently and driving different decisions, deliberately never merged. Check whether the corpus already supplies both: the Louvain motif-community family (44 families, with confidence grades) and the cultural tradition carried by FROM_TRADITION edges and tradition_families, which no prior reviewer has used. Determine which classification the backward-looking hatch mapping actually wants (inferred, graded, per-instance) and which the forward-looking §11.6 loot targeting wants (stable, announceable, learnable before a run), and whether they are the same object. Read §11.6 verbatim before answering, and say what the cross-index costs and what breaks if the two are fused now.

Confidence and refusal — the honest limits of a sign-based naming. families.json grades its own families high, medium, and low; individual motif and power edges carry provenance confidence; eidogen dimensions can be not-applicable. Assess whether the wing scheme can carry sign strength as a first-class term rather than treating every membership as equally true, and — against this lens's own bias toward always producing a name — identify at least one concrete case where the run signature or the creature's signs are too thin to justify any wing attribution, and state what the system shows the player in that case instead of a confident label it cannot support.

severity_examples.condition: Escalate to P0 only if you have verified the sign-coverage figure yourself against data/creatures/*.yaml and can state both denominators; a substrate claim asserted from the family export alone is P1 at most.
severity_examples.scenario: The wing is implemented as a set of families because that is what 'wing biases family pools' literally says, and the entire hatch-legibility premise is therefore built on a substrate that can only describe a minority of the 645-creature roster — while a sign vocabulary covering nearly all of it already exists in the corpus, unused, so the shortfall is a choice nobody knowingly made rather than a limit of the data.

severity_examples.condition: P1 rather than P2 because the defect is in the shape of the mechanism rather than its parameters: no amount of weight tuning produces a narratable reason, so the legibility goal fails structurally.
severity_examples.scenario: The three hatch signals are combined by a weighted sum with no precedence rule, so when the wing points one way and the roster's kill-share heredity points another there is no fact of the matter about which the system followed — the pick-of-3 screen cannot name a reason that is true, and every later tuning pass moves weights without anyone able to say what the change means.

Signals moving on different clocks are summed into one score — an accumulated cross-run kill-share heredity, a single run's playstyle, and an externally assigned wing — so the same wing produces systematically different hatches early and late in a save for reasons the design never intended and the player reads as inconsistency rather than as their colony having a history.

Family confidence grades and per-edge sign confidence are discarded in the wing definition, so a wing built partly on medium-confidence clusters asserts the same tonal certainty as one built on high-confidence clusters, and the flavor text claims a coherence the source clustering does not structurally support.

source_domain: Pattern-differentiation diagnosis in pre-modern medicine — the Sinitic 辨證論治 tradition (the eight principles 八綱 as a small orthogonal axis set, the four examinations 四診合參 with their explicit conflict rule 舍脈從證 / 舍證從脈, compound patterns 兼證, root-and-branch priority 標本緩急, and the sovereign–minister–assistant–envoy 君臣佐使 roles in formula composition), read alongside Ayurvedic prakṛti/vikṛti (stable constitution versus present derangement) and Greco-Arabic assessment of temperament (mizāj) from multi-channel signs.
success_hints: Verify the sign substrate before you build on it. Scan /Users/sma/projects/jawnomicon/data/creatures/*.yaml relations blocks for HAS_MOTIF and HAS_POWER edges and count them yourself; a preliminary scan indicates roughly 2372 motif and 1363 power edges across the 645 files, about 639 creatures carrying at least one sign, around 807 distinct sign targets with roughly 207 appearing on five or more creatures, and about 94 of the ~101 creatures outside every v16 family still carrying signs. Recompute rather than quote. Note also that two of the 546 v16 member ids have no matching creature file (one absorbed into another creature, one differing by a slug-normalization character), so state which denominator your percentages use.

Read the families.json fields no prior reviewer has used: top_shared_vocab with its frequency annotations is already a family-level sign profile, confidence grades each family high/medium/low, tradition_families gives a second orthogonal classification of the same members, and rationale states in prose what the cluster actually shares. These four fields are where a sign-profile proposal gets its real content instead of inventing one.

Read the canon passages verbatim rather than through the brainstorm's summary, and engage the ones that constrain you. §11.4's absolute no-magic-find rule and §12.1's 'one behavior twist + tint, plus a drop-table bias' are this project's own shipped precedent for bias that never gates. §12.3's 'the rooms never change. The fauna changes' is the strongest argument for keeping the wing name stable while what it biases varies by consumer. §12.4 is the counterweight you must price against honestly: a sign-profile scorer is new machinery on a loop that has not been play-validated, so say what the cheapest version of your proposal is and whether it captures most of the benefit.

Do the magnitude arithmetic before proposing any term. calculateMatchScore sums roughly twenty-one confidence-weighted similarity terms plus a 0.2 trope bonus and a 0.1 emotional bonus; the ledger already measured those bonuses at a few percent of a realistic total. State where your sovereign term sits in that sum, in numbers, so that 'sovereign' is a mechanical fact and not a metaphor.

Propose one concrete scheme rather than an argument for one. Name the axes, name the wings as positions in them, give the sign profile for at least two wings using real motif slugs, give the precedence rule with the condition that fires it, and give the literal sentence the pick-of-3 screen prints. A specific scheme with its numbers attached is worth far more than a critique of the straw set.

Guard against this lens's own reflex. The tradition always produces a name, and a coherent narration is not evidence that the mechanism produced the ranking. For every justification string you propose, say what the system would have to compute for that string to be true, and include at least one case where the right output is a refusal to name a wing.
task_context:
Ideate and evaluate alternatives for the Borgesroom wing-set v0 in After Them — the themed wing identity each delve run rolls, which biases the encryptid matcher's family pools and makes run→creature hatching legible ('this run became this creature'). The current straw proposal is five tonal wings mapped to jawnomicon families: Funerary (Death-Criers/Underworld Court/Night-Comers), Tempest (Tempest-Bringers/Rain-Serpents/Rain-Holders/Maelstrom-Makers), Hearth (Hearth-Bound/Kindly Watchers/Blessing-Bearers/First Teachers), Hungers (Lurking Hunters/Hungers That Think/Monstrous Broods/Wings of Ill Omen), Mirrors (Tricksters/Shape-Thieves/Never-Caught). The four questions are: (1) Is wing-as-tonal-theme the right taxonomy axis at all, against alternatives by record type, eidogen dimension cluster, media-feature region, enemy ecology, or player-verb affordance? (2) Is five the right count for Beat 1, given each wing must be felt often enough to build literacy? (3) How should wing bias compose with roster kill-share heredity and pace/aggression/thoroughness playstyle so hatches stay legible but not deterministic — and never hard-gate the 645-creature roster? (4) The wings serve TWO consumers — hatch mapping now, loot-farming literacy later (§11.6) — do the two jobs pull toward different taxonomies, and if so which taxonomy serves both?

The design under review is a brainstorm at docs/brainstorms/2026-08-09-habitat-place-brainstorm.md; the wing set is its Open Question #1 and Key Decision #9, and it is unresolved. This is a STEER-WIDE lens in a multi-round melange. Six lenses have already run — faceted classification and information architecture, ARPG loot bias versus hard gates, live-service data architecture for multi-consumer taxonomies, perfumery olfactive-family construction, heraldic marshalling and cadency, and pre-modern calendrics and almanac design — producing 35 findings that are settled input, not your target. They collectively established the coverage and hard-gate arithmetic, the absent composition formula and the negligible magnitude of the existing bonus terms, the untracked playstyle signals, the missing wing field in RunReportSource, the axis-mixing in the straw set, the coupon-collector exposure cost, and the undecided roll mechanism. What every one of them shares is the assumption that a wing is a bin the corpus gets sorted into and that the evidence about a run agrees with itself. Your mandate is the pair of moves none of them has a primitive for: the category as a weighted profile of presenting signs generated from a small axis set rather than a curated member list, and an explicit rule of precedence and abandonment for evidence channels that disagree, in place of a weighted average.

Ground every claim in the actual sources; do not trust summaries. Primary: docs/research/2026-08-09-meta-home-loop-teardowns.md, game-design-docs/teardown-arpg-modifiers.md §§11-12 (especially 11.4, 11.6, 12.1, 12.3, 12.4), game-design-docs/after-them-delve-formation.md (R1-R8), /Users/sma/projects/jawnomicon/exports/families/v16/families.json (44 families with member lists, top_shared_vocab, confidence grades, tradition_families and rationales), /Users/sma/projects/jawnomicon/data/creatures/*.yaml (the per-creature relations blocks carrying HAS_MOTIF, HAS_POWER and FROM_TRADITION edges with provenance confidence — the substrate no prior lens has read), /Users/sma/projects/jawnomicon/data/families-prose.yaml (family blurbs), src/sim/habitat/types.ts (MediaFeatures), src/sim/habitat/encryptidMatcher.ts (scoring), src/ui/RunReport.ts (available run facts). Grade findings P0 (would corrupt or block the whole design), P1 (a real defect that will cost significant rework), P2 (a genuine but contained problem), P3 (worth recording). Prefer a small number of grounded, arithmetic-backed findings with a concrete alternative attached over a broad sweep of plausible concerns.
